title: The Light of the World
old_p1: Long before Jesus was born, Isaiah, a prophet who spoke for Heavenly Father, said, “The people who walked in darkness have seen a great light.”
Darkness here is a picture-word for feeling sad and lost. Light means Jesus’s love, which shows us the way.
The night Jesus was born, bright light shone around the shepherds. It was the glory of the Lord, His shining goodness.
old_p2: When Jesus grew up, He said, “I am the light of the world. Whoever follows Me will not walk in darkness.” Isaiah was talking about Jesus! At Christmas, many families put up twinkly lights. Each light can help us remember Him.
Tonight, look at one little light. Jesus can shine in your heart too.
p1: Long before Jesus was born, Isaiah told what Heavenly Father said. “The people who walked in darkness have seen a great light.”
Many people felt sad and lost then, like walking in the dark. Isaiah promised that a great light would come to them.
The night Jesus was born, a bright light shone around the shepherds. It was the Lord’s own shining glory.
p2: When Jesus grew up, He said, “I am the light of the world.” He said whoever follows Him will not walk in darkness. Isaiah was talking about Jesus!
A light shows us the way, and so does Jesus. Tonight, look at one little light and remember Jesus.
